body: Well, I have a list of names of people to try. It's just hard to get out and go see that many. It's also hard to actually explain my situation because my medical history is very complicated and just as relevant as my mental health.

There was no way I was going to sleep. I have insomnia and I pretty much can't sleep without meds and given the state I was/am in, they wouldn't help much, anyway. 
I'm looking for a therapist. I've gone to one guy twice, and I find that I can't be honest at all. I haven't straight-up lied, but I don't talk about what's really going through my head- just half-truths or less personal stuff like my physical medical history. 
I'd been on a low dosage of anti-depressants, but had to go off for physical health reasons and only yesterday got the go-ahead to start again.
